description: SwiftUI extension for CronSettings, providing views and UI components for managing cron jobs within the application, including job listing, editing, deletion confirmation, and status banners.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Displays a warning banner if the cron scheduler is disabled, including optional store path information.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header section with title, description, and action buttons for refreshing jobs and adding new ones.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Main content area with a list of jobs, error/status display, and job details.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Displays detailed information and run history for a selected job or prompts to select a job.
